title: Task 4: wire verify script + audit bundle + docs
description:
Objective: make the inventory/coverage artifacts first-class in verification and audit tooling.

Files:
- Modify: packages/core/scripts/verify-dnd5e-srd-pack/cli.ts — regenerate inventory+coverage and diff against committed artifacts (same exact-match contract as records.json)
- Modify: packages/core/scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/cli.ts — copy artifacts into bundle reports/ and surface unaccounted count + known-gap count in metadata.json and final summary
- Modify: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/README.md — document tier map, artifact shapes, rule curation lifecycle (when an epic child lands, its known-gap rule is REMOVED so the gate enforces the new coverage)
- Check: hidden-unicode script extensions list covers the new .json artifacts (it scans .json already)

Steps:
1. Failing check: run npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack after hand-corrupting a committed artifact copy in a temp dir (or unit-test the comparison function). Implement diff. Restore. Commit.
2. Audit bundle: add artifact copy + metadata fields. Run npm run audit-bundle:dnd5e-srd locally to confirm. Commit.
3. README update. Commit.
4. npm run verify:worktree (full gate) then push branch + open PR per AGENTS.md. PR summary must follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md required reporting (affected IDs: none in records.json; new artifacts explained; commands run).
acceptance_criteria: verify script fails on artifact drift and passes on clean regeneration; audit bundle includes artifacts and counts; npm run verify:worktree green; PR open
close_reason: verify:dnd5e-srd-pack now enforces the gate and byte-diffs both artifacts (fails exit 1 on hand-corrupted artifact, exit 0 clean); audit bundle copies artifacts into reports/ with sourceCoverage roll-up in metadata.json; importer README documents tier map, artifact shapes, and rule-curation lifecycle.
